description:
[Trading Data API] Block header lookup: number, hash, timestamp, miner, tx count, gas used/limit and base fee — Block header lookup: number, hash, timestamp, miner, tx count, gas used/limit and base fee. Latest by default, or any block number, safe or finalized.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-block?chain=base&block=latest`

block.description: Optional. A block number, "latest", "safe" or "finalized" (default latest).

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

name: chain_block
